thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1: elevated tail latency in prod-us-east1 (p95 > 1.1s) and increased 5xx. Triggered by multi-monitor correlation.
anne: Ack - oncall. I'm seeing traffic imbalance to a subset of edge nodes in us-east1. Repro rate ~2.5% 5xx.
raj: I'm looking at LB logs. There's a sudden connection queue depth on the east ingress. Could be slow downstream responses.
mike: Runs: `curl -sS https://edge.east.health/metrics | jq '.connections'` shows many TIME_WAITs. Suspect connection churn to cache/backends.
leila: Can we do a graceful failover to us-central while we investigate east? We should validate first with a synthetic canary.
anne: Yes. Plan: create quick synthetic job in us-central to validate a few endpoints, then shift 30% traffic for 5m, watch p95 & 5xx, then increase.
infra-bot: Command: `traffic-shift start --from=us-east1 --to=us-central1 --pct=30 --duration=5m --validate=synthetic-canary`
ops-bot: Synthetic canary job `smoke-canary-us-central` created and executed: 10/10 requests OK, avg latency 210ms.
raj: Canary good. Initiating shift.
mike: Noting KV-cache miss rate in us-east1 increased by ~3x. Adding cache replica to east and throttling new connections from bursty clients.
leila: Live mitigation: cache scaled +2, outbound connections for pool east-7 restarted to clear stuck connections.
anne: After shift p95 in east dropped from 1.3s -> 780ms, 5xx dropped by 60%. Good. Holding shift at 70% to central to confirm stability.
raj: Quick customer-impact note: a handful of sessions dropped between 20:05-20:12 UTC. Support ticketing group notified.
leila: For follow-up: alert tuning needed - current latency alert fires on 1m window which causes churn. Propose: change latency -> 5m rolling p95 and require sustained deviation. Also add region-specific thresholds.
mike: Suggest adding a Prometheus recording rule for regional p95 to speed queries and avoid flapping:
```
- record: regional:request_p95:5m
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))
```
leila: Also add an alert: `RegionalHighP95` with for: 10m, labels: severity=page if region QPS > baseline*0.2 else severity=warn. That reduces noise for low-traffic regions.
raj: We should dedupe pages coming from multiple monitors for the same root cause (e.g., cache pressure). Proposing a new alertmanager grouping rule: group_by: ['cluster', 'region', 'alertname', 'cause_signature_hash']
anne: Add suppression during automated rollouts and traffic shifts to prevent paging for expected transient latencies. We can use a silence when `traffic-shift` flag is active.
infra-bot: Applied temporary 30m suppression tag `in-progress-traffic-shift` to related alerts.
ops-bot: Creating ticket INF-4602: "Alert tuning + multi-region failover dashboard" assigned to eng-infra. Will include suggested recording rules, alert changes, and grouping rules.
leila: Dashboard work: need a side-by-side panel showing traffic proportion, regional p95, 5xx rate, cache miss rate, and instance health. Panel IDs we'll include in the ticket: 112, 113, 114, 115.
mike: Also recommend a small alert pipeline: first-level warning to #monitoring for 5m, escalate to oncall if persists 10m. Include a transient-flapping filter.
raj: For cache-specific early warning, add a rate-of-rate alert: alert if `increase(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[1m])[5m]) > threshold` — this would have caught the rapid surge earlier.
anne: Post-incident tasks: 1) Update runbook with synthetic-canary pre-shift step, 2) Implement recording rule and updated alerts (INF-4602), 3) Build multi-region dashboard (INF-4602-DASH), 4) Add alertmanager grouping & suppression rules (INF-4603).
leila: I'll own the canary/runbook update. Mike take the recording rules & alerts. Raj take the dashboard.
mike: I'll prototype the alert changes in staging and run a sensitivity sweep for false positives. Will post results.
ops-bot: Incident timeline saved to incident-doc: https://redwood-internal/incidents/1802238890 (private)
anne: Oncall handoff: I'll hand primary to raj in 90 minutes. Leaving detailed mitigations in the doc.
raj: Taking handoff. Leaving a short checklist: monitor `regional:request_p95:5m`, `kv_cache_miss_total`, `tcp_time_wait_count`, and `edge_5xx_rate`. If any trend > 2x baseline, re-escalate.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: auto-close after mitigation verified. time_to_ack: 2m, time_to_recover: 14m. Tags: regional-failover, alert-tuning, synthetic-canary
leila: Quick retro note: need better pre-emptive canary coverage for all critical API paths. Adding INF-4604 for canary coverage expansion.
anne: Good job team. After action: we'll run a tabletop next week focusing on cross-region failover and alert noise reduction.
